text: Still wishing to find the answers. <break time="0.8s" /> The king decided to visit a hermit. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was famous for his wisdom. <break time="0.8s" /> The hermit lived in a forest. <break time="0.8s" /> And never left it. <break time="0.8s" /> And he met only. <break time="0.8s" /> Simple, common people. <break time="0.8s" /> So the king put on simple clothes. <break time="0.8s" /> And leaving his bodyguards behind. <break time="0.8s" /> He walked to the hut alone. <break time="0.8s" /> When the king arrived. <break time="0.8s" /> The old hermit was digging the ground. <break time="0.8s" /> In front of his hut. <break time="0.8s" /> He was so weak. <break time="0.8s" /> That he breathed heavily. <break time="0.8s" /> Every time he pushed his spade. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the earth. <break time="0.8s" /> The king went up to him. <break time="0.8s" /> And said. <break time="0.8s" /> I have come to you, wise hermit. <break time="0.8s" /> To ask you three questions. <break time="0.8s" /> The hermit listened to the questions. <break time="0.8s" /> But he answered nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> And went on digging. <break time="0.8s" /> You are tired. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the king. <break time="0.8s" /> Let me take the spade. <break time="0.8s" /> And work for a while. <break time="0.8s" /> The hermit gave him the spade. <break time="0.8s" /> And sat down on the ground. <break time="0.8s" /> And the king dug two beds. <break time="0.8s" /> When the king asked his questions again. <break time="0.8s" /> The hermit only stood up. <break time="0.8s" /> And held out his hand. <break time="0.8s" /> For the spade. <break time="0.8s" /> But the king did not give it back. <break time="0.8s" /> And kept digging. <break time="0.8s" /> Until the sun began to sink. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind the trees.
